title: Five independent four-field cyclic codes with adaptive decoding

claims.statement: The explicit product of five four-field degree-50 cyclic encoders and their shared radius-11 adaptive list decoder carry 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 773356200462581483/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=2520497841559917180 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(61129/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), orbit count, nominal tails, field and operation bound (1), auxiliary child tails (2), and weighted admission and occupancy (3).
